errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the x-axis categories are arranged in alphabetical order. The categories are ordered by increasing company size: "До 50", "До 250", "250-500", etc.

The description incorrectly identifies the x-axis label, "Размер на компанията (брой служители)", as the categories. The categories are the specific intervals of company size (e.g., "До 50", "До 250").
